alerts.title: Database Connection Crisis
alerts.summary: database: Database connection pool exhausted, causing cascading failures in 5 dependent services: order-service, inventory-service, payment-service, user-service, api-gateway.

evidence: database reported 'Connection pool exhausted' at 14:25:12
database connection pool utilization rose from 50% to 100% between 14:23:00 and 14:25:12
Early warning at 14:24:31: 80% and rising, projected exhaustion in ~1m 00s
4 services failed calling database from 14:25:12: inventory-service (18), user-service (17), order-service (9), payment-service (6)
api-gateway failing on inventory-service, order-service, payment-service, user-service (34 errors)
6 services began failing in a chain (each within 30s of the previous failure; first-to-last 163s)

suggested_actions: 1. Page the database on-call; check pool size, max_connections and long-running queries
2. Increase the database connection pool size (and the DB's max_connections)
3. Check for connection leaks: connections not returned to the pool
4. Find long-running queries or transactions holding connections
5. Review recent deployments for connection handling changes

alerts.title: Payment Provider Health Checks Failing - Cascading Failure Across 5 Services
alerts.summary: payment-provider: Health checks failing - service down or unreachable, causing cascading failures in 4 dependent services: payment-service, order-service, api-gateway, web-app.

root_cause_analysis.probable_cause: Health checks failing - service down or unreachable (payment-provider)
evidence: payment-provider reported 'Service health check failed: Connection refused' at 14:44:50
1 service failed calling payment-provider from 14:44:52: payment-service (40)
web-app failing on order-service, payment-service (40 errors)
order-service failing on payment-service (15 errors)
5 services began failing in a chain (each within 30s of the previous failure; first-to-last 31s)
order-service error rate 10.91% (baseline 5.882%)

suggested_actions: 1. Check the service's process, dependencies and recent deployments
2. Restart or fail over unhealthy instances
3. Fix the root-cause service first; dependents should recover on their own
4. Shed load / open circuit breakers on dependents to stop retry amplification

alerts.title: Performance Degradation: Rising Database Query Time Affecting 3 Dependent Services
alerts.summary: Database query time rose to 172ms (2.39x the 72ms baseline) and is still trending up; dependents also slowing: order-service, search-service, api-gateway. At this rate it crosses 1000ms in about 2m 56s.

root_cause_analysis.probable_cause: Database query time rising: 172ms vs 72ms baseline (2.4x)
evidence: Database query time 172ms vs 72ms baseline (2.39x, rising: Kendall tau 0.63 over 14 samples)
order-service request latency 388ms vs 142ms baseline (2.73x, rising: Kendall tau 0.77 over 20 samples)
api-gateway request latency 388ms vs 178ms baseline (2.18x, rising: Kendall tau 0.67 over 20 samples)

suggested_actions: 1. Check recent deployments and traffic changes for the slow component
2. Inspect slow-query logs / query plans and dependency latency
3. Scale out or shed load before latency reaches the timeout threshold

alerts.title: Elevated Error Rate Across 10 Services
alerts.summary: 10 services show elevated error rates with 62 distinct error signatures and no shared failing dependency; likely background noise or a broad change (deploy/config).

root_cause_analysis.probable_cause: No common root cause: heterogeneous errors across unrelated services
evidence: 62 distinct error signatures across 10 services; no failing dependency shared between them
'Failed to connect to <*> timeout' x16
'Invalid request format' x14
'Connection pool exhausted' x14
user-service error rate 100% (baseline 1.439%)
api-gateway error rate 75% (baseline 0.1%)

suggested_actions: 1. Check for a recent deployment or config change affecting many services
2. Inspect the top error signatures; fix or silence known-noisy ones
3. Watch for any one service or dependency standing out (it would page separately)
